title: Pom Pom Sorting
summary: Sort soft pom poms into matching colored cups using little fingers.
steps: Place a pom pom of each color into the bottom of each cup.
Spread the rest on the tray.
Show your child how to match one pom pom into the right cup.
Step back and let them work at their own pace.
cleanup: Tip the cups back onto the tray and store pom poms in a jar.

title: Tongs Transfer
summary: Move cotton balls from one bowl to another using kitchen tongs.
steps: Place full bowl on the left, empty bowl on the right.
Demonstrate squeezing the tongs around one ball.
Transfer slowly across to the empty bowl.
Invite your child to try.
cleanup: Return cotton balls to a single bowl and rinse tongs.

title: Threading Pasta
summary: Thread dry penne onto a shoelace to make a wearable necklace.
steps: Tie a knot at one end of the lace.
Show how to pick up one piece of pasta.
Slide it onto the lace.
Repeat — tie the ends together when full.
cleanup: Untie and store pasta in a sealed jar for reuse.

title: Playdough Pinching
summary: Pinch small pieces off a ball of playdough and roll them into beads.
steps: Set the playdough on the plate.
Demonstrate pinching off a pea-sized piece.
Roll between thumb and index finger.
Line the beads up along the edge.
cleanup: Press all the beads back into a ball and store in an airtight container.

title: Sticker Peel & Place
summary: Peel stickers from a sheet and place them inside drawn shapes on paper.
steps: Draw 8–10 circles on the paper.
Show your child how to lift the corner of a sticker.
Peel it off and press it inside a circle.
Continue until each circle is filled.
cleanup: Fold the paper and recycle, store leftover stickers flat.

title: Clothes Pin Clip
summary: Clip wooden clothes pins around the rim of a basket or cardboard circle.
materials: A small basket or cardboard plate
steps: Place the pins on a tray within reach.
Demonstrate squeezing one open with thumb and finger.
Clip it onto the rim.
Encourage your child to fill the rim.
cleanup: Unclip and store the pins in a small jar.

title: Button Snake
summary: Slide large fabric squares with buttonholes onto a button-tipped ribbon.
materials: 4–6 felt squares with a slit in the middle
steps: Hold the button end of the ribbon.
Show your child how to push the button through a felt slit.
Slide the square down the ribbon.
Continue until all squares are on.
cleanup: Slide the squares off and roll the ribbon up.

title: Water Dropper Painting
summary: Use a pipette to drop colored water onto absorbent paper.
steps: Place the paper on the tray.
Show how to squeeze, dip, and release the dropper.
Let your child explore mixing colors drop by drop.
cleanup: Pour leftover water down the drain and lay paper flat to dry.

title: Coin Slot Drop
summary: Drop large wooden coins or buttons through a slot cut in a container lid.
steps: Adult cuts a coin-shaped slot in the lid.
Set the container on the table.
Demonstrate dropping one coin through the slot.
Open the lid to reveal — repeat.
cleanup: Empty container and store coins inside with the lid sealed.

title: Nuts and Bolts
summary: Match and twist large plastic nuts onto matching bolts.
materials: Set of large plastic nuts and bolts
steps: Spread nuts and bolts on the tray.
Demonstrate finding the matching pair.
Twist the nut on slowly.
Unscrew and start again.
cleanup: Pair each set and return to a small zip bag.

title: Lacing Cards
summary: Thread a shoelace through the holes around a cardboard shape.
steps: Knot one end of the lace through the first hole.
Show 'up through the hole, pull tight'.
Move to the next hole.
Continue around the shape.
cleanup: Pull the lace out and stack the cards in a folder.

title: Color Drop Ice Cubes
summary: Drip food-colored water onto a tray of plain ice cubes to watch them melt.
steps: Set ice on the tray.
Show your child how to fill the pipette.
Squeeze drops onto each cube.
Watch the colors run as the ice melts.
cleanup: Pour melted water down the sink and dry the tray.

title: Rice Scooping
summary: Scoop dry rice from one bowl to another using a small spoon.
steps: Place one full bowl, one empty bowl on the tray.
Demonstrate one slow scoop and pour.
Hand the spoon to your child.
Let them transfer at their pace.
cleanup: Sweep spilled rice back into the bowl and seal.

title: Paper Tearing Collage
summary: Tear colored paper into strips and glue them onto a sheet.
steps: Demonstrate pinching the paper and pulling outward.
Tear several strips together.
Glue them onto the base in any pattern.
Let dry flat.
cleanup: Recycle scraps and cap the glue stick.

title: Pipe Cleaners & Colander
summary: Push pipe cleaners through the holes of an upside-down colander.
steps: Turn the colander upside down on the table.
Show how to push one pipe cleaner through a hole.
Encourage filling every hole.
Wiggle them to feel resistance.
cleanup: Pull out the pipe cleaners and bundle them with a tie.

title: Stacking Rings
summary: Stack rings on a central post in order from largest to smallest.
steps: Remove all rings and place on a mat.
Demonstrate lifting the largest first.
Slide it onto the post.
Continue down to the smallest.
cleanup: Restack the rings on the post when finished.

title: Nesting Cups
summary: Nest a set of graduated cups inside each other or build a tower.
steps: Spread the cups out on a mat.
Demonstrate placing the smallest into the next size.
Or build a tall tower.
Knock over and restart.
cleanup: Nest all cups inside the largest one.

title: Magnetic Fishing
summary: Catch paper fish with paper-clip mouths using a magnet on a string.
steps: Place all fish in the basket.
Show your child how to lower the magnet.
Lift slowly when a fish attaches.
Place each catch in a cup.
cleanup: Remove paper clips into a small tin and store fish flat.

title: Zipper Practice Board
summary: Practice opening and closing a large zipper on a fabric board.
materials: An old jacket or DIY zipper board
steps: Sit beside your child.
Demonstrate pinching the zipper pull.
Pull slowly down, then back up.
Let them try both directions.
cleanup: Leave the zipper open and store flat.

title: Velcro Strips Stick & Pull
summary: Stick and unstick small velcro shapes onto a strip on a board.
steps: Place all shapes on a tray.
Demonstrate pressing one onto the board.
Pull it off and replace.
Let your child cover the whole board.
cleanup: Stack shapes in a small dish.

title: Buckle Practice
summary: Open and close a row of seatbelt-style buckles on a board.
materials: DIY buckle board or backpack with buckles
steps: Set the board flat on the table.
Demonstrate pressing the release tab.
Slide the two pieces back together.
Repeat slowly with each buckle.
cleanup: Leave buckles fastened and store flat.

title: Clip Card Matching
summary: Clip a clothes pin next to the correct picture on a card.
steps: Lay one card on the table.
Discuss the picture together.
Show squeezing the pin onto the matching answer.
Move to the next card.
cleanup: Remove the pins and stack cards in a folder.

title: Sponge Squeeze Transfer
summary: Soak a sponge in one bowl and squeeze the water into another.
steps: Place one bowl of water and one empty bowl on a towel.
Dip the sponge until full.
Lift slowly and squeeze over the empty bowl.
Repeat until the first bowl is empty.
cleanup: Wring the sponge out and lay flat to dry.

title: Dot Stamping
summary: Press a dot marker or finger paint onto outlined circles on paper.
steps: Set the paper down flat.
Demonstrate pressing the marker into one circle.
Lift and try the next.
Encourage full coverage.
cleanup: Cap markers and hang artwork to dry.

title: Cotton Ball Spooning
summary: Move cotton balls from one bowl to another using a spoon.
steps: Set up bowls on the tray, balls in one.
Demonstrate scooping one ball.
Carry slowly across.
Tip it into the empty bowl.
cleanup: Return cotton balls to one bowl and store.

title: Hole Punching
summary: Squeeze a hole punch around the edges of paper to create patterns.
materials: A small bowl for paper dots
steps: Hand your child the paper.
Show how to slide the edge into the punch.
Squeeze with both hands if needed.
Move along the edge.
cleanup: Empty paper dots into the recycling bin.

title: Toothpicks in Cheese
summary: Push toothpicks into a block of soft cheese or playdough.
materials: Block of soft cheese or playdough
steps: Place the block on the plate.
Demonstrate the pincer grip on a toothpick.
Push it into the surface.
Continue until full.
cleanup: Remove toothpicks into a small dish and recycle the block.

title: Ribbon Pull-Through Box
summary: Pull lengths of ribbon out through holes in a tissue box.
steps: Thread ribbons through the box opening.
Show your child how to grasp and pull.
Encourage pulling slowly to see the full length.
Repack when done.
cleanup: Restuff ribbons inside the box for next time.

title: Knob Puzzles
summary: Lift wooden puzzle pieces out by the knob and return them to the correct spot.
steps: Set the puzzle in front of your child.
Lift one piece out using the knob.
Talk about the shape underneath.
Help fit it back in place.
cleanup: Snap all pieces back in their slots.

title: Scissor Snipping
summary: Make small snips along the edge of paper strips with safety scissors.
steps: Hand your child the scissors thumb-up.
Hold the strip taut with your hand.
Show one open-close snip.
Catch clippings in the bowl.
cleanup: Tip clippings into the recycling bin.

title: Sticky Contact Paper Wall
summary: Press lightweight items (pom poms, leaves, feathers) onto a contact-paper sticky wall.
steps: Tape a sheet of contact paper sticky-side out at child height.
Show pressing one item on the surface.
Encourage your child to fill the wall.
Peel items off to start again.
cleanup: Roll the paper up sticky-side in for next session.

title: Ice Tray Transfer
summary: Place one small object (bead, pom pom) into each well of an ice cube tray.
steps: Set the tray and bowl side by side.
Demonstrate placing one object per well.
Talk about 'one in each'.
Empty and start again.
cleanup: Tip objects back into the bowl and rinse the tray.

title: Rainbow Rice Sensory Bin
summary: Scoop, pour and dig through a bin of dyed rice and hidden treasures.
steps: Pour rice into the bin.
Hide a few toys.
Offer scoops and let your child explore.
cleanup: Sweep stray rice into the bin and seal in a container.

title: Finger Painting
summary: Mix and smear washable paint directly with fingers on big paper.
steps: Tape paper down.
Put dollops of paint on the page.
Invite your child to spread and mix.
cleanup: Roll paper to dry and wipe hands with a warm cloth.

title: Pour Your Own Water
summary: Pour from a small pitcher into a cup at snack time.
steps: Fill the pitcher halfway.
Demonstrate a slow pour.
Let your child try at snack time.
cleanup: Wipe spills with the sponge and refill for next meal.

title: Picture Book Naming
summary: Point to and name objects on the page of a favorite picture book.
materials: A picture book with clear illustrations
steps: Sit together with the book.
Point and clearly name one object.
Pause for your child to repeat or point.
Turn the page together.
cleanup: Return the book to the shelf.

title: Cloud Dough
summary: Squeeze and mold a silky flour-and-oil dough that holds shapes.
materials: 1 cup baby oil or vegetable oil
steps: Mix flour and oil in the bin until it feels like damp sand.
Show your child how to pack it into a cup.
Tip it out to make a mound.
Encourage squishing and squeezing.
cleanup: Scoop dough into an airtight container — it keeps for weeks.

title: Taste-Safe Jelly Bowl
summary: Squish a bowl of plain gelatin with hidden fruit pieces inside.
steps: Set fruit in the bowl, pour gelatin over and chill until firm.
Set on a tray with a bib on.
Invite your child to poke, squish and dig out the fruit.
cleanup: Compost leftovers and wipe the tray with warm water.

title: Frozen Fruit Discovery
summary: Explore the cold, hard, then soft textures of frozen berries.
materials: A small bowl of frozen berries
steps: Tip the berries into the bowl.
Demonstrate touching one with a fingertip.
Talk about 'cold' and 'soft' as they thaw.
Taste together if your child is ready.
cleanup: Wipe the tray and rinse the bowl.

title: Tapioca Pearl Bin
summary: Scoop and squeeze cooked tapioca pearls — a taste-safe water-bead alternative.
steps: Pour pearls into the bin.
Show your child how to squish a handful.
Offer cups to scoop and pour.
cleanup: Bin pearls in the compost or trash and rinse the bin.

title: Cooked Spaghetti Worms
summary: Run fingers through cooked, cooled spaghetti tossed with a drop of oil.
steps: Toss spaghetti with oil so strands separate.
Pile it on the tray.
Invite squishing, pulling and stretching.
cleanup: Compost the spaghetti and rinse the tray.

title: Dry Oat Sensory Bin
summary: Scoop and pour dry rolled oats with cups and spoons.
steps: Pour oats into the bin.
Show your child how to fill and tip a cup.
Let them dig, scoop and pour freely.
cleanup: Funnel oats back into a sealed jar — reuse many times.

title: Dry Pasta Bin
summary: Dig through different shapes of dry pasta for hidden spoons.
steps: Pour pasta into the bin and bury a few items.
Invite your child to find them.
Talk about shapes and sounds as it moves.
cleanup: Store pasta in a sealed jar for reuse.

title: Whipped Cream Tray
summary: Smear, swirl and taste a tray of plain whipped cream.
steps: Spread whipped cream across the tray.
Show one finger drawing a line.
Let your child smear, swirl and lick.
cleanup: Wipe the tray with a warm cloth.

title: Ice Melt Discovery
summary: Watch ice cubes melt with a pinch of salt and warm water drops.
steps: Place ice on the tray.
Sprinkle a little salt.
Drip warm water on with a spoon and watch the changes.
cleanup: Pour melted water into the sink and dry the tray.

title: Warm & Cold Bowls
summary: Dip hands into bowls of warm and cool water and compare.
steps: Set bowls side by side on a towel.
Demonstrate dipping one hand in each.
Talk about 'warm' and 'cool'.
cleanup: Pour water out and dry hands and bowls.

title: Texture Touch Board
summary: Run fingers across scraps of fabric glued to a card: silk, felt, corduroy, fleece.
steps: Glue 4–6 fabric squares onto the board.
Sit together and run a finger across each.
Name each texture: soft, bumpy, smooth.
cleanup: Store the board flat on a shelf.

title: Nature Treasure Basket
summary: Explore a basket of safe natural objects: pinecones, smooth stones, shells.
materials: Pinecones, large smooth stones, large shells, leaves
steps: Set the basket on the floor.
Sit close and pick up one item at a time.
Name it and let your child explore it.
cleanup: Return treasures to the basket on a shelf.

title: Spice Smell Jars
summary: Sniff small jars of mild kitchen spices and herbs.
steps: Place a pinch of each spice in a jar.
Cover with a paper lid with holes.
Invite your child to sniff and name.
cleanup: Empty jars into a sealed container — reuse for weeks.

title: Sound Shakers
summary: Shake bottles filled with rice, beans, or bells and match the sounds.
steps: Fill each bottle a third of the way.
Glue the lids on tight.
Shake one at a time and listen together.
cleanup: Store bottles in a basket on the shelf.

title: Crinkle Fabric Basket
summary: Squish and pull a basket of crinkly fabrics, ribbons and scarves.
steps: Fill the basket with mixed crinkly items.
Sit on the floor together.
Pull each out and listen to the sounds.
cleanup: Refold items and tuck back into the basket.

title: Baby-Safe Mirror Play
summary: Make faces, point and name body parts in a sturdy mirror.
steps: Sit your child in front of the mirror.
Point to your nose, then theirs.
Make happy and surprised faces.
cleanup: Wipe the mirror and store flat.

title: Flashlight Shadow Play
summary: Make hand shadows on the wall with a small flashlight in a dim room.
steps: Dim the lights.
Shine the flashlight at the wall.
Show how to make a hand shadow.
Take turns guessing shapes.
cleanup: Turn the flashlight off and open the curtains.

title: Bubble Wrap Stomp
summary: Stomp, pat and pop a taped-down sheet of bubble wrap.
steps: Tape the wrap flat on the floor.
Demonstrate stepping and patting.
Encourage stomps, hand pats and crawling.
cleanup: Recycle the popped sheet.

title: Sponge Texture Exploration
summary: Compare dry, damp and wet sponges of different sizes.
steps: Set one dry, one damp, one wet sponge on the tray.
Squeeze each one in turn.
Talk about how they feel.
cleanup: Wring sponges out and lay flat to dry.

title: Herb Garden Touch & Smell
summary: Touch and smell fresh kitchen herbs from a pot or bouquet.
materials: Small pot of mint, basil or rosemary
steps: Sit with the herbs at a low table.
Show how to rub a leaf gently between fingers.
Smell your fingers together and name the herb.
cleanup: Return the herbs to the windowsill.

title: Wet & Dry Rice
summary: Compare scooping dry rice with wet (slightly damp) rice in two bins.
steps: Set one bin of each rice on a tray.
Scoop, pour and pack each one.
Compare how they move and feel.
cleanup: Compost damp rice and save dry rice in a jar.

title: Oobleck Play
summary: Mix cornflour and water to make a goo that's solid when squeezed, liquid when relaxed.
steps: Mix cornflour and water in the tray slowly.
Show how to scoop and let it drip.
Let your child squeeze and release.
cleanup: Scoop into the trash (not the sink) and wipe with warm water.

title: Paper Rip & Toss Bin
summary: Rip pages from junk mail into a big bin and toss them in the air.
steps: Sit with the bin between you.
Demonstrate ripping one page.
Toss scraps in the bin and shower them down.
cleanup: Tip scraps into the recycling bin.

title: Veggie Stamping
summary: Stamp paint shapes onto paper using cut celery, okra and apple halves.
materials: Cut veggies (celery base, halved apple, okra)
Washable paint in a shallow dish
steps: Pour paint into a flat dish.
Show dipping a veggie in and pressing onto paper.
Talk about the patterns each one makes.
cleanup: Compost the veggies and rinse the dish.

title: Potato Stamp Prints
summary: Press carved potato halves into paint to make repeating prints.
steps: Adult carves a simple shape into each potato half.
Dip into paint.
Press firmly onto the paper.
Repeat in rows.
cleanup: Compost potatoes and rinse the dish.

title: Cotton Ball Clouds
summary: Glue cotton balls onto blue paper to make a sky full of clouds.
steps: Hand your child the paper.
Rub glue in a cloud shape.
Press cotton balls into the glue.
Add a sun if you like.
cleanup: Hang to dry and tidy leftover cotton.

title: Tissue Paper Collage
summary: Tear and stick squares of tissue paper onto contact paper.
steps: Tape contact paper sticky-side up to the table.
Show pressing a tissue square on.
Fill the sheet with colors.
cleanup: Peel and hang as window art.

title: Leaf & Twig Painting
summary: Use leaves, twigs and pine needles as paintbrushes.
steps: Set out the natural 'brushes'.
Dip one into paint.
Drag and dab across the paper.
Try each tool.
cleanup: Compost the brushes and rinse the dish.

title: Ice Cube Painting
summary: Slide melting ice cubes of colored water across paper.
materials: Ice cubes frozen with food coloring
steps: Freeze water with a drop of color in each ice well.
Set paper on the tray.
Show sliding a cube across the page.
cleanup: Pour leftover water down the sink and dry the tray.

title: Straw Blow Painting
summary: Blow drops of watery paint across paper with a straw.
steps: Drop blobs of paint on the paper.
Show your child how to blow gently through the straw.
Watch the blobs spread.
cleanup: Toss straws and lay paper flat to dry.

title: Yarn Painting
summary: Drag paint-dipped yarn across paper to make swirly lines.
steps: Pour paint into a plate.
Lay a yarn piece in the paint.
Lift and drag across the paper.
cleanup: Toss yarn and let paper dry flat.

title: Cardboard Box House
summary: Decorate a small cardboard box with crayons and stickers to make a tiny house.
steps: Cut a door and window (adult).
Hand the box to your child.
Color the walls and decorate with stickers.
cleanup: Use the house as a toy or recycle it.

title: Paper Plate Faces
summary: Glue scraps onto a paper plate to make a funny face.
steps: Lay the plate flat.
Glue on yarn hair, paper eyes and mouth.
Add crayon details.
cleanup: Hang to dry and tidy the scraps.

title: Crayon Rubbings
summary: Lay paper over leaves and coins, then rub a crayon flat to reveal them.
steps: Set a leaf under the paper.
Show rubbing the side of a crayon over it.
Watch the texture appear.
cleanup: Return items and store paper flat.

title: Salt & Watercolor
summary: Trace glue lines, sprinkle with salt, then dab watercolor for magical patterns.
steps: Draw lines and shapes with glue.
Sprinkle salt over and tip off excess.
Touch watercolor onto the salt and watch it travel.
cleanup: Shake salt into the trash and dry artwork flat.

title: Bubble Print Art
summary: Blow bubbles in colored soapy water with a straw and press paper on top.
materials: Cup of water + soap + food coloring
steps: Adult supervises straw-in not suck-up.
Blow until bubbles dome over the cup.
Press paper gently on top.
cleanup: Pour soapy water down the drain and rinse the cup.

title: Rolling Pin Painting
summary: Roll a paint-dipped rolling pin across paper for instant murals.
steps: Pour paint in a long shallow tray.
Roll the pin through it.
Roll back and forth on the paper.
cleanup: Rinse the pin and roll up the paper to dry.

title: Fork Painting
summary: Drag a fork through paint to make grass, fur and hair textures.
steps: Pour paint on a plate.
Dip the fork tines in.
Drag across the paper to make lines.
cleanup: Toss the fork and rinse the plate.

title: Handprint Animals
summary: Press a painted hand onto paper and turn the print into an animal.
steps: Paint your child's palm.
Press firmly onto paper.
Once dry, draw eyes and legs to make an animal.
cleanup: Wash hands well and lay artwork flat to dry.

title: Footprint Art
summary: Stamp painted little feet onto paper for a butterfly or a heart.
steps: Sit your child on a towel.
Paint one foot at a time.
Press onto the paper and lift straight up.
cleanup: Wash feet in the bowl and dry artwork flat.

title: Egg Carton Creatures
summary: Paint sections of an egg carton and add pipe cleaner legs to make bugs.
steps: Cut the carton into 2-cup rows (adult).
Paint each cup.
Once dry, poke pipe cleaner legs in.
cleanup: Display the creatures or recycle them later.

title: Cardboard Tube Stamps
summary: Dip the rim of toilet paper rolls in paint to stamp circles, hearts and flowers.
steps: Pinch tubes into different shapes (heart, oval).
Dip the rim in paint.
Press onto the paper.
cleanup: Recycle the tubes and rinse the dish.

title: Edible Yogurt Paint
summary: Mix plain yogurt with food coloring for an edible 'paint' on paper or a high chair tray.
steps: Mix small amounts of yogurt with a drop of color each.
Dollop onto the tray.
Let your child paint and lick.
cleanup: Wipe the tray with a warm cloth.

title: Chalk on Black Paper
summary: Draw with chalk pastels or sidewalk chalk on black construction paper.
steps: Sit at the table with paper flat.
Show drawing big strokes.
Smudge with a fingertip.
cleanup: Shake paper outside and wash hands.

title: Wet Chalk Drawing
summary: Dip chalk in water and draw bold, bright lines on dark paper.
steps: Dip the chalk tip in water.
Press onto the paper and drag.
Compare to dry chalk.
cleanup: Lay chalk flat to dry.

title: Sponge Painting
summary: Dab clean cut sponges into paint and press onto paper.
steps: Pour paint in a flat dish.
Press a sponge in, then onto paper.
Repeat with each color.
cleanup: Rinse the sponges and hang artwork to dry.

title: Tape Resist Art
summary: Stick painter's tape to paper, paint all over, peel to reveal clean lines.
steps: Press strips of tape on the paper.
Paint freely over everything.
Once dry, peel the tape to reveal the design.
cleanup: Toss tape and dry artwork flat.

title: Nature Collage
summary: Glue leaves, petals and small twigs onto a card to make a nature picture.
steps: Take a walk and collect treasures.
Lay them out on the card.
Glue them down one at a time.
cleanup: Hang the card and compost extras.

title: Play Silk Draping
summary: Drape, swirl and twirl colorful play silks for free expression.
steps: Set silks in a basket.
Demonstrate tossing one in the air.
Drape them on shoulders and over furniture.
cleanup: Fold silks and return to the basket.

title: Mud Painting
summary: Paint with mud outside on cardboard or a wooden fence.
steps: Mix mud in a bowl.
Hand your child the brush.
Paint freely on the cardboard.
cleanup: Hose down hands and compost the cardboard.

title: Set the Table
summary: Set a placemat, plate, cup and spoon for each person at mealtime.
steps: Lay a placemat out together.
Place a plate in the center.
Add the cup and spoon.
Repeat for each person.
cleanup: Clear after the meal together.

title: Napkin Folding
summary: Fold cloth napkins into halves and quarters before a meal.
steps: Lay one napkin flat.
Demonstrate folding edge to edge.
Fold in half again.
Stack in the basket.
cleanup: Store the basket near the table.

title: Banana Slicing
summary: Slice a peeled banana with a butter knife at snack time.
steps: Lay the banana on the plate.
Show holding the knife with one hand.
Press straight down to slice.
cleanup: Eat the slices and wash the plate together.

title: Spreading on Toast
summary: Spread soft butter or jam onto a slice of toast with a butter knife.
steps: Set toast on a plate.
Scoop a little spread on the knife.
Show smoothing across the toast.
cleanup: Eat and wash the plate together.

title: Peeling a Mandarin
summary: Peel a small mandarin orange and place segments in a bowl.
steps: Score the peel with a fingernail (adult).
Show pulling a piece of peel off.
Drop segments into the bowl.
cleanup: Compost the peel and enjoy the fruit.

title: Washing Veggies
summary: Rinse cherry tomatoes or grapes under cool water in a colander.
steps: Place the colander in the sink.
Tip the fruit in.
Show your child how to rinse and shake.
cleanup: Tip into a bowl and dry the colander.

title: Dish Washing Station
summary: Wash a few unbreakable dishes in a small basin of soapy water.
steps: Set basins on a low table over a towel.
Show dipping a cup, scrubbing with a hand.
Rinse in the second bowl.
Set on the towel to dry.
cleanup: Pour basins out and hang the towel.

title: Dusting Shelves
summary: Use a small cloth to dust a low shelf or windowsill.
steps: Hand your child the cloth.
Show wiping in a long, slow motion.
Move along the shelf.
cleanup: Shake the cloth outside and put it away.

title: Plant Watering
summary: Water houseplants with a small watering can or jug.
steps: Fill the can halfway.
Show pouring slowly at the base of the plant.
Move to the next plant.
cleanup: Empty extra water and store the can.

title: Flower Arranging
summary: Trim and arrange fresh flowers in small vases for the table.
steps: Pour water into each vase.
Show trimming a stem.
Place one flower per vase.
cleanup: Compost trimmings and place vases around the home.

title: Laundry Sorting
summary: Sort clean laundry into piles: socks, shirts, towels.
steps: Sit by the basket together.
Pull out one item at a time.
Sort into piles on the floor.
cleanup: Carry piles to their drawers together.

title: Matching Socks
summary: Find matching pairs of socks and roll them together.
materials: A basket of mixed clean socks
steps: Tip socks onto the floor.
Pick one sock.
Hunt for its pair.
Roll them together.
cleanup: Put pairs in the sock drawer.

title: Sweeping Practice
summary: Sweep a circle of dry rice into a dustpan with a child-size brush.
materials: A small pile of dry rice
steps: Pour rice in a small circle on the floor.
Show short brush strokes toward the dustpan.
Tip into a bowl when done.
cleanup: Pour rice back into a jar for reuse.

title: Wiping the Table
summary: Wipe crumbs off the table with a damp cloth after a meal.
steps: Hand your child the cloth.
Show sweeping crumbs into the bowl.
Wipe the whole table.
cleanup: Rinse the cloth and hang it to dry.

title: Polishing Pebbles
summary: Buff smooth stones with a soft cloth and a tiny dab of olive oil.
materials: Tiny dish with a drop of olive oil
steps: Pick up one stone at a time.
Touch the cloth to the oil.
Rub in small circles to make it shine.
cleanup: Wipe stones with a dry cloth and store.

title: Carrying a Tray
summary: Carry a tray with a cup of water across the room without spilling.
steps: Place the cup in the middle of the tray.
Show holding with two hands.
Walk slowly to the table.
cleanup: Empty the cup and store the tray.

title: Opening Containers
summary: Practice opening and closing different lids and containers.
materials: A basket of clean containers with lids (screw, snap, pop)
steps: Set containers on the floor.
Show twisting or popping each lid.
Encourage your child to try each one.
cleanup: Close each container and return to the basket.

title: Dressing a Doll
summary: Practice taking clothes on and off a soft doll.
steps: Sit with the doll on a mat.
Show pulling a shirt over the doll's head.
Try pants, socks, hat.
cleanup: Fold the clothes and put doll to bed.

title: Naming Body Parts
summary: Point to and name body parts during diaper changes or bath time.
steps: Say 'this is your nose' and touch it.
Pause and look for a response.
Move to ears, toes, tummy.
cleanup: Carry on naming throughout your day.

title: Song With Actions
summary: Sing 'Wheels on the Bus' or 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' with hand actions.
steps: Sit facing your child.
Sing slowly and do each action big.
Pause and look — invite them to copy.
cleanup: Round off with a cuddle.

title: Animal Sound Matching
summary: Match toy animals with their sounds: 'moo', 'baa', 'quack'.
materials: A few toy farm or zoo animals
steps: Hold up one animal.
Say its name and make its sound.
Pause for your child to copy.
Move on to the next.
cleanup: Return animals to the basket.

title: Object Basket Naming
summary: Pull familiar everyday objects from a basket and name each one.
steps: Sit together with the basket.
Pull out one item.
Name it clearly and let your child explore it.
Move to the next.
cleanup: Return items to the basket.

title: Emotion Faces
summary: Look at photos of faces and name the feeling: happy, sad, surprised.
materials: Printed photos or a feelings book
steps: Sit and look at one face at a time.
Name the feeling: 'she is happy'.
Make the face together in a mirror.
cleanup: Store the photos or book on the shelf.

title: Picture Card Sorting
summary: Sort picture cards into groups: animals, food, vehicles.
steps: Label each basket out loud.
Show sorting one card into the right basket.
Hand cards to your child one at a time.
cleanup: Stack the cards and store the baskets.

title: Story Stones
summary: Pull painted stones from a bag and make up a story together.
materials: 5–6 small painted stones (cat, sun, house, tree)
steps: Pull one stone out.
Say a sentence: 'Once there was a cat…'.
Pull another and continue.
cleanup: Drop stones back in the bag.

title: Nursery Rhyme Time
summary: Sing a familiar nursery rhyme and pause for your child to fill in the missing word.
steps: Sing 'Twinkle Twinkle Little ___' slowly.
Pause and look.
Celebrate any attempt to fill in.
cleanup: Finish with a hug.

title: Peekaboo Object Reveal
summary: Hide a familiar object under a cloth and name it as you reveal it.
steps: Place a toy under the cloth.
Say 'where's the ball?'
Pull the cloth — 'there it is!'
Repeat with each toy.
cleanup: Tuck items back in the basket.

title: Follow a Simple Command
summary: Give one short instruction: 'bring me the cup', 'put the ball in the box'.
steps: Get your child's attention.
Give one clear short instruction.
Wait and celebrate the response.
cleanup: Return objects to their place.

title: Food Naming Tray
summary: Name fruits and veggies one by one on a tray at snack time.
steps: Set the tray in front of your child.
Point and name each food.
Eat together and chat about colors.
cleanup: Eat the snack and wash the tray.

title: Family Photo Talk
summary: Look through a small album of family faces and name each person.
materials: A small photo album with familiar faces
steps: Sit together with the book.
Turn to one photo.
Say 'this is Grandma' — pause.
Turn the page together.
cleanup: Place the album back on the shelf.

title: Sound Guess Bag
summary: Make a sound with a hidden object and guess what it is.
steps: Put an item in the bag.
Make its sound out of sight.
Pull it out and name it together.
cleanup: Return items to the basket.

title: Animal Figure Stories
summary: Use toy animals to act out a simple two-line story.
steps: Set animals on the mat.
Say 'the cow eats grass' and move it.
Invite your child to make the cow walk too.
cleanup: Return animals to the shelf.

title: Echo Words
summary: Say a fun sound or word and pause for your child to copy.
steps: Get face to face.
Say a clear sound: 'baba', 'moo', 'up!'
Pause and smile expectantly.
cleanup: Round off with a tickle.

title: Mirror Conversation
summary: Sit with your child at a mirror and narrate what you both do.
steps: Sit with the mirror in front.
Say 'we are smiling, I see your nose'.
Make faces and name them.
cleanup: Wipe the mirror and put away.

title: Book Flip & Name
summary: Flip through a board book and name one item per page.
steps: Sit together with the book.
Open one page.
Point and clearly name one thing.
Turn the page.
cleanup: Return the book to the shelf.

title: Sequencing Cards
summary: Put three picture cards in order to tell a simple story (wake up, eat, play).
steps: Shuffle the three cards.
Lay them face up.
Talk through which comes first.
Arrange together left to right.
cleanup: Stack the cards and store flat.

title: Weather Words
summary: Look out the window each morning and name the weather.
steps: Walk to the window together.
Say 'it is sunny / cloudy / rainy'.
Make a hand motion for each — sun, rain falling.
cleanup: Return to your morning routine.

title: Finger Counting Rhyme
summary: Recite '1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — once I caught a fish alive' tapping each finger.
steps: Hold up your hand.
Tap each finger as you count.
Slow the rhyme and pause for your child to copy.
cleanup: Round off with a high five.

title: Animal Walk Parade
summary: Stomp like an elephant, hop like a bunny and waddle like a duck across the room together.
steps: Pick three animals to start.
Demonstrate each walk — bear crawl, bunny hop, duck waddle.
Call out one animal and move together across the room.
Switch animals every few steps.
cleanup: Flop down for a cuddle when the parade is done.

title: Couch Cushion Mountain
summary: Build a soft cushion pile and climb, crawl and tumble safely with a grown-up spotting.
steps: Pile cushions on the floor against the couch.
Show your child how to climb up on hands and knees.
Spot them as they crawl over and slide down.
Rebuild and repeat.
cleanup: Stack cushions back on the couch together.

title: Dance Party Freeze
summary: Play a favourite song, dance freely, then freeze every time the music stops.
steps: Start the music and dance together.
Pause the song and call 'freeze!'
Hold still until the music returns.
Vary the speed — slow stretchy moves to fast wiggles.
cleanup: End with a slow song and a snuggle.

title: Balloon Keep-It-Up
summary: Tap a balloon back and forth to keep it from touching the floor.
steps: Toss the balloon gently into the air.
Show your child how to tap it back up with one hand.
Count out loud each time it gets tapped.
Try with two hands, then with feet.
cleanup: Pop and bin the balloon when finished — never store deflated.

title: Living Room Obstacle Course
summary: Crawl under chairs, jump over pillows and balance along a tape line.
materials: Dining chairs or a small tunnel
steps: Lay tape in a straight line on the floor.
Set up a pillow to jump over and a chair to crawl under.
Walk the course with your child once, narrating each step.
Let them run it solo and time them with claps.
cleanup: Roll up the tape and stack cushions away.

title: Sit & Roll Ball
summary: Sit on the floor facing each other and roll a soft ball back and forth.
materials: A soft fabric or playground ball
steps: Sit facing your child with legs in a V.
Roll the ball slowly toward their hands.
Cheer when they catch and roll it back.
Widen the gap as their aim improves.
cleanup: Tuck the ball back in the toy basket.

title: Tunnel Crawl
summary: Crawl through a play tunnel or a row of dining chairs draped with a blanket.
materials: A play tunnel OR 2 chairs and a blanket
steps: Set up the tunnel on a soft surface.
Crouch at one end and call your child through.
Take turns crawling in opposite directions.
Hide a soft toy inside as a surprise.
cleanup: Fold the blanket and put chairs back.

title: Bubble Chase
summary: Blow bubbles outside and let your toddler chase, pop and stomp them.
steps: Step outside to a safe open area.
Blow a stream of bubbles low to the ground.
Encourage your child to pop them with hands then feet.
Take turns being the blower.
cleanup: Cap the bubbles and wipe sticky hands.

title: Ribbon Twirl Dance
summary: Wave long ribbons through the air to music — big circles, little wiggles, high and low.
materials: 2 long ribbons taped to short sticks
steps: Hand your child one ribbon and keep one yourself.
Mirror each other's moves — circles, waves, figure eights.
Move ribbons high then low, fast then slow.
Dance around the room together.
cleanup: Wind ribbons around their sticks and store flat.

title: Paper Stepping Stones
summary: Step from one paper 'stone' to the next without touching the 'water' floor.
materials: 6–8 sheets of paper or felt squares
steps: Lay the papers in a winding path on the floor.
Hold your child's hand for the first try.
Step from stone to stone — narrate 'jump, balance, hop'.
Rearrange the path for a new challenge.
cleanup: Stack the papers and reuse next time.
